title: Fictional qualitative education protocol test

units_of_analysis: novice secondary-school teachers and their accounts
phenomena_or_topics: negotiating classroom authority during the first year of teaching
relationships_or_questions: how participants describe authority, identity, and classroom interaction
geographic_scope: not restricted in this fictional test configuration
scope.temporal_scope: First year of teaching; publication dates to be justified during search design

subquestions: How do novice teachers define and describe classroom authority?
Which interactions or incidents do participants identify as shaping that authority?
How do school and cultural contexts enter participants' accounts?
How do qualitative methods and researcher positioning shape the interpretations?
Which tensions, negative cases, or divergent accounts are reported?

concept_definitions.label: Novice teacher
concept_definitions.definition: A teacher in the first year of professional classroom practice.
concept_definitions.boundaries: Studies combining career stages must make first-year accounts separately interpretable.

concept_definitions.label: Classroom authority
concept_definitions.definition: Participants' accounts of legitimacy, control, responsibility, and relational influence in the classroom.
concept_definitions.boundaries: Formal job authority alone is insufficient without classroom experience or interpretation.

concept_definitions.label: Culturally diverse school
concept_definitions.definition: A school context described by the source as culturally, linguistically, ethnically, or migration-background diverse.
concept_definitions.boundaries: The source's operational description must be retained rather than normalized into one measure.

include: Reports qualitative empirical accounts from first-year or separately identifiable novice secondary-school teachers
Addresses classroom authority or a directly defined equivalent in a culturally diverse school context
Provides enough data-collection and analytic detail to assess the interpretation
exclude: Reports only student achievement or classroom-management scores without participant interpretation
Combines career stages so first-year teacher accounts cannot be identified
Uses diversity or authority only as incidental background

strategy_groups.name: Participant experience
strategy_groups.purpose: Locate qualitative accounts of novice teachers negotiating classroom authority.

strategy_groups.name: Context-sensitive accounts
strategy_groups.purpose: Locate studies where cultural or linguistic diversity is part of the interpreted setting.

evidence_extensions.name: participants_or_cases
evidence_extensions.label: Participants or cases
evidence_extensions.description: Who or what supplied the qualitative accounts.

evidence_extensions.name: sampling_strategy
evidence_extensions.label: Sampling strategy
evidence_extensions.description: How participants or cases were selected.

evidence_extensions.name: data_collection
evidence_extensions.label: Data collection
evidence_extensions.description: Interview, observation, document, or combined data collection.

evidence_extensions.name: researcher_positioning
evidence_extensions.label: Researcher positioning
evidence_extensions.description: Reported positionality or researcher relationship to the setting.

evidence_extensions.name: negative_case
evidence_extensions.label: Negative case
evidence_extensions.description: Divergent or disconfirming account relevant to the interpretation.

resolved: This file is fictional test configuration and performs no search.
